column1: # systemd components: kind  name  key  description  flags (see lib/components.sh)
mode  failed  -  failed services of both managers  -
mode  timers  -  timers of both managers: next and last run  -
mode  sockets  -  sockets of both managers: what they listen on  -
toggle  files  alt-u  user, system: static, masked, generated and alias unit files too (not loaded)  -
sort  state  -  failed, running, other active, inactive, then not loaded (timers: next run first)  -
action  reload   alt-L   reload (restart when the unit cannot reload)  foreground,reload
action  daemon-reload  -  reload the manager's unit files (the selection's managers)  foreground,reload
action  journal  ctrl-l  follow the journal (timers, sockets: of the unit they activate; ctrl-c returns)  foreground
action  edit     ctrl-e  systemctl edit (drop-in override)   foreground,reload
